## Checklist

- [ ] Tests added or updated (`deno task test` passes)
- [ ] `deno task build` passes (format, lint, types, docs check, `deno doc --lint`)
- [ ] Docs updated for any user-visible change, linked from the folder `README.md` (see [CONTRIBUTING](../CONTRIBUTING.md#documentation))
- [ ] New error messages documented in the [error catalog](../docs/reference/errors.md)
- [ ] Behavior changes noted in the [changelog](../CHANGELOG.md) and the [migration guide](../docs/migration/README.md)
